'''Droat milk''' was a type of [[Milk/Legends|milk]] that could be served in a dish.<ref name="Death Star" /> Sometime between [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]] and [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="DSdate">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Death Star (novel)|Death Star]]'' to the [[Time/Legends|time]] range of [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]]&ndash;[[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].</ref> [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Natasi Daala]] had begun thinking of her duties aboard the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|DS-1 Orbital Battle Station]] as being about as interesting as curdled droat milk, and she felt that her superior, [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]], comprehended that.<ref name="Death Star" />

==Behind the scenes==
Droat milk was mentioned in [[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']], a [[2007]] novel written by [[Michael Reaves]] and [[Steve Perry]].<ref name="Death Star" />
